description: Happy path: cascade:ProxyAgent (a parent operating a minor's Pod) with actsForPatient, proxyRelationship, proxyScope, and proxyGrantedAt (core v3.3)
notes: core v3.3 added cascade:ProxyAgent to close the caregiver-proxy gap. ProxyAgentShape requires cascade:actsForPatient (sh:minCount 1), cascade:proxyRelationship (xsd:string, sh:minCount 1), and cascade:proxyGrantedAt (xsd:dateTime, sh:minCount 1). proxyScope is optional.
